title: Fynaptix · Weekly Brief
heading: Emerging Tech Weekly
subheading: Nine sectors · one view · Refreshes Mondays ~12:30pm
disclaimer: Not financial advice · do your own due diligence

sector_scoreboard.story: Oracle was cut from Watch to Avoid after the BIS and RBA put the first official numbers on AI circular financing (55.2% of AI-firm investment funded by other AI firms; US$1–1.5T of off-balance-sheet hyperscaler obligations), while Nvidia lifted its buyback by $150B.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: OpenAI is seeking $30B+ at a $1.4T pre-money as a bridge to a delayed IPO; the $825–855B top-five capex bill is now being measured by regulators, not just bears.

sector_scoreboard.story: Teradyne dropped from Core to Watch after a +8% day to ~$449 on a ~200% 12-month run — good business, wrong price — while Tesla’s Giga Texas Optimus plant reached ~40% steel completion and Musk halved AI5 memory to free supply for Optimus.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Optimus is still a late-2027 limited-production story, and industrial-automation leaders are being priced ahead of the evidence.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. The Pentagon gave Neros ~$100M for 14,000+ FPV drones after Gauntlet II (again a private winner), L3Harris landed a ~$6B THAAD propulsion contract, and a continuing resolution to Dec 11 freezes 150+ new programs.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Demand is intact (~$2.89T global spend, Europe heading to 3.5% of GDP), but Golden Dome and the $54.6B DAWG line cannot start under the CR.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. Term uranium hit a 19-year high of $96/lb while nuclear equities kept falling; the NRC permitted TVA’s Clinch River BWRX-300, Constellation signed a 690 MW Amazon PPA, and NuScale put a $750M ATM in focus.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Cameco’s Q1 realized price was only $65.45/lb vs $96 term — the gap is the thesis — but there are still zero operating commercial SMRs and Clinch River carries no disclosed cost, start date or partner.

sector_scoreboard.story: Critical Metals was added at Avoid (~$1.1B market cap on ~$2M of exploration revenue) as thaw hopes drained the scarcity premium: MP Materials −15.8% in 30 days, REMX −17%, USA Rare Earth −23%.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: The sell-off prices a US-China thaw while the Nov 10 export-reprieve cliff stands untouched; Glencore and Mercuria’s $1B into the VaultCo stockpile shows floors only reach projects that exist.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. Starship Flight 14 reached orbit with all 26 Starlink V3 satellites and SPCX rose 7.4% to ~$159; Rocket Lab fully funded Iridium with a $1.94B at-the-market sale and B.Riley cut AST SpaceMobile to Neutral.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Up to 1.3B SpaceX lockup shares unlock after Q3 earnings with SPCX at ~$2.2T, and RKLB trades above 40x annualized revenue.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. Tesla deployed 13.7 GWh of storage in Q3 (second-best quarter ever) with the margin print still ahead, and Enphase began domestic production of AI data-center power modules.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Fluence’s guidance cut (~$2.4B revenue, ~−$200M adj. EBITDA), SEC probe and class action keep weighing on the stack; GE Vernova (~$939) needs its backlog to reach $200B in early 2027.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. Tempus AI closed at $76.63, ~10% above the average target, with its $1.5B all-stock Personalis deal still unclosed; Illumina is up ~108% YTD at $273 against a Hold consensus; the FDA accepted Intellia’s BLA for lonvo-z.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: The Guardant/Tempus litigation (Markman hearing Oct 20) is unresolved, and Recursion sits at $4.19 with 33% short interest.

sector_scoreboard.story: Quantinuum moved from Speculative to Watch after a fresh 52-week low ($46.42) on ~$8M of quarterly revenue and an EPS miss at ~528× trailing sales, while IonQ unveiled a real-time error-correction decoder benchmarked to 408 logical qubits.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: The pure-plays gave back more of September’s bounce (IonQ −3.8%, Rigetti −8.5%, D-Wave −9.4%); a Benchmark analyst sizes 2026 industry revenue at only ~$1.5B.

cross_cutting_themes.title: Four moves across nine sectors — every one a cut
cross_cutting_themes.description: Oracle (Watch to Avoid), Teradyne (Core to Watch), Quantinuum (Speculative to Watch) and the newly added Critical Metals (Avoid) were the only stance changes, and there were no upgrades. Each is a real business or a credible technology whose price had outrun the evidence.

cross_cutting_themes.title: Regulators put numbers on AI circularity
cross_cutting_themes.description: The BIS found 55.2% of AI-firm investment comes from other AI firms, and the RBA sized hyperscaler off-balance-sheet obligations at US$1–1.5T. Oracle (FY26 FCF −$23.7B, BBB−) took the cut; Nvidia’s $150B buyback increase and depreciation defence are the other side of the argument.

cross_cutting_themes.title: A weak jobs print eased the squeeze — for now
cross_cutting_themes.description: September payrolls added just 29,000 (consensus ~84,000) with unemployment up to 4.2%; October-hike odds fell to ~14% from ~70% and the 10-year eased to 5.18%. That is still near 2007 highs, which keeps pressure on long-duration pre-revenue names in quantum, SMRs and biotech.

cross_cutting_themes.title: The news is real; the market is trading something else
cross_cutting_themes.description: Term uranium hit a 19-year high while nuclear equities kept falling, and Western rare-earth names lost 16–23% on thaw hopes with China’s licensing regime unchanged. In Teradyne’s and Quantinuum’s cases the opposite held: the price ran ahead of the evidence.

cross_cutting_themes.title: The calendar is the catalyst
cross_cutting_themes.description: A continuing resolution to Dec 11 freezes 150+ new defense starts including Golden Dome, China’s rare-earth reprieve expires Nov 10, and Anthropic’s roadshow is reportedly slated for the week of Nov 9 — policy dates, not earnings, set the next leg.

news_of_the_week.title: September payrolls miss badly: +29,000 vs ~84,000 expected
news_of_the_week.description: Unemployment rose to 4.2% and CME FedWatch odds of an October hike collapsed to ~14% from ~70%; the 10-year fell to 5.18% and equities caught a bid.

news_of_the_week.title: BIS and RBA publish the first official measures of AI circular financing
news_of_the_week.description: BIS Bulletin 137: 55.2% of AI-firm investment came from other AI firms; the RBA put hyperscaler off-balance-sheet and vendor-financed obligations at US$1–1.5T. Oracle was cut to Avoid.

news_of_the_week.title: Starship Flight 14 reaches orbit; SpaceX +7.4% to ~$159
news_of_the_week.description: All 26 Starlink V3 satellites deployed despite an ascent engine shutdown; Crew-13 launched and Alphabet’s Project Suncatcher prototype landed the same week. Analysts’ average target is $235.

news_of_the_week.title: NRC issues TVA’s Clinch River BWRX-300 construction permit
news_of_the_week.description: Completed in 14 months, four months early, and only the second US advanced-reactor construction permit in a decade — but TVA has disclosed no cost, start date or financing partner.

news_of_the_week.title: Pentagon awards Neros ~$100M for 14,000+ FPV drones
news_of_the_week.description: The first big Drone Dominance production order went to a private company; Red Cat, Ondas and Kratos missed the top five.

week_ahead.title: FOMC minutes
week_ahead.description: First detailed look at the Sept 16 hike debate, now that October-hike odds have fallen to ~14%.

week_ahead.title: Treasury auctions
week_ahead.description: Supply into a ~5.2% 10-year after the soft jobs print.

week_ahead.title: Jobless claims & consumer sentiment
week_ahead.description: A quiet tier-one data calendar; pre-announcements ahead of Q3 earnings start to matter.

week_ahead.title: Guardant/Tempus Markman hearing
week_ahead.description: Follow-on to the $245.2M TwinStrand judgment, under appeal.

week_ahead.title: Q3 earnings & Tesla energy margin
week_ahead.description: Hyperscaler results, GE Vernova’s backlog test and Tesla’s full Q3 energy-segment margin all land in the back half of the month.

week_ahead.title: Anthropic roadshow (reported)
week_ahead.description: Reported plan: roadshow the week of Nov 9, trading before Thanksgiving at $1.8–2.0T — later than the earlier October target.

week_ahead.title: China rare-earth reprieve expires
week_ahead.description: Untouched by the Sept Washington visit; the next hard test for the minerals complex.

stance_changes.name: Oracle
stance_changes.why: The RBA’s Oct 1 warning on US$1–1.5T of off-balance-sheet hyperscaler obligations lands on Oracle’s model (FY26 FCF −$23.7B, BBB−); not owned until funding risk clears.

stance_changes.name: Teradyne
stance_changes.why: Real business (Gen 7 cobots, first $100M robotics quarter) but a +8% day to ~$449 after a ~200% run puts valuation ahead of the evidence.

stance_changes.name: Quantinuum
stance_changes.why: Fresh 52-week low of $46.42 after ~$8M of quarterly revenue and an EPS miss, at ~528× trailing sales.

stance_changes.name: Critical Metals
stance_changes.why: New this week: ~$1.1B market cap on ~$2M of exploration revenue and no producing asset.

footnote: About this brief: compiled each Monday from the nine sector dashboards and the week’s stance changes. Momentum reflects news flow and fundamentals, not price; risk-gauge scores are subjective. Research & education — not financial advice.
